title: Shulchan Arukh Yoreh Deah — Wikisource English 131 and 132 (partial)
attribution: Shulchan Arukh by Joseph Karo with Rema glosses; English translations by Wikisource contributors. See source-manifest.json for pinned revisions and contributor histories. CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Selected paragraphs from one source revision, removed page navigation and interleaved Hebrew, and escaped text for the reader. Adapted text remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Selected passages 131:2 and 132:3–4, each partial because the local Hebrew contains added material missing from the source translation. Other sections are withheld; 132:1 reverses a rule and 132:2 omits a condition. Translation was compared with adjacent Hebrew but is not independently proofread; source history does not establish the translation method.
